scene: You climb onto the roof, where three whimsical transit platforms await departure.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along a rooftop platform deck. Far left sits an ornate clockwork carousel train on brass tracks. Left stands the girl with high bun, sky-blue windbreaker, cargo shorts, and sketchbook. Centre floats an iridescent bubble lift tied to a mooring pole. Right sits a bright, paint-splattered tram with doors wide open.
shown: a mechanical clockwork carousel train with open brass cars idling on the left
a shimmering giant bubble lift tethered to a centre platform dock
a paint-splattered street tram with open sliding doors on the right
